title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Interest and Other Payments on Economic and Technological Development Loans) (No. 2) Notification 2004

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Income Tax (Exemption of Interest and Other Payments on Economic and Technological Development Loans) (No. 2) Notification 2004.

2. There shall be exempt from tax the rents (including advance, basic and supplemental rents) payable by Singapore Airlines Cargo Pte Ltd from 28th November 2003 to 21st August 2015 (both dates inclusive) to Singapore Emma Finance I S.A.S. under the Finance Lease Agreement dated 28th November 2003 in respect of one Boeing Model 747-400F (Aircraft Manufacturer’s Serial No. 32898).
